See bd-01KZY1YJ426SEKJM6Q4THDAR7J. The R CMD check claim in certification-report.md is attached to HEAD b5d9a33 and has not been re-run since. Added since: 20 untracked R files (10708 lines), 40 modified tracked files, 43 new man pages, 26 new S3method entries. No .Rcheck directory and no tarball anywhere in the repo.

The suite is green (1819 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn) but testthat does not check Rd syntax, usage-versus-formals agreement, undocumented arguments, S3 registration consistency, NAMESPACE coherence, or CRAN-incoming rules - which is the entire surface the existing claim rests on. Your own report at line 210 records that a prior rerun caught a real namespace note (five head() calls missing an importFrom), so this class of defect has already recurred once here.

Recommend re-running R CMD check --as-cran before this epic records anything, and citing the output plus the commit it ran against. If the existing wording is kept, it should state which commit it describes and that later work is uncertified.
